newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 7.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 7.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
-- Foreign Minister Laszlo Kovacs said ahead of the NATO summit to decide on NATO enlargement that the majority of Hungarians would vote in favour of Hungary's NATO membership in a referendum.
-- Hails and a 100-kilometre winds caused a total damage of more than 200 million forints in eastern Hungary.
-- A flood alert may be introduced along the upper stretch of the river Danube in Hungary.
-- President Arpad Goncz has invited Jordanian king Hussein to visit Hungary.
